title: TargetAttributionV1 — Plan-bound sidecar INPUT for resolved target endpoints (DRAFT, isolated successor)
description: Typed separate INPUT record. It is NOT a native fact payload field and MUST NOT be added to foundation/relation-payload-schemas.v2.json $defs. Bound to PlanId + source fact2 + the producing provider closure. Points at the fact; the fact has no backlink (no cycle). Identity is raw SHA-256 of C(this record); not an H-domain. Provider attribution truth is trusted after host join validation. First-party inventory lookup MAY derive an equivalent record when unambiguous; otherwise this sidecar or kind/occupancy unknown. Never parse SubjectIdV1 spelling to invent kind or occupancy. Standing: draft only; frozen21 and live repo untouched. Root owns ProofInputRef domain integration.

planId.description: The Plan whose evaluation consumes this input. Closure requires the named fact2 to belong to this Plan's views. planId is a locator, not hashed as a parent into EnumerationPlanV1.

sourceFactId.description: The native fact whose target endpoint this record attributes. Unique with planId: at most one TargetAttributionV1 per (planId, sourceFactId).

producerClosure.description: Must equal the source fact's producerClosure. The named closure must be Plan-selected. This is the trusted attribution producer, not a second fact mint.

targetUniverse.description: Bare 64-hex suffix of the TARGET endpoint universe. Must equal sourceFact.targetUniverse. Never silently swapped with sourceUniverse.

targetNativeId.description: Exact native target identity copied from the fact payload's resolved target-id field (resolvedTarget / resolvedBinding / resolvedCallee / to / reachable). Compare this to the current evaluation subject's nativeSubjectId BEFORE kind/occupancy: a different nativeId is a known nonmatch even if kind is unknown.

kind.description: Stored kinds are file|symbol|package. unknown is explicit metadata, not a fourth subject kind and not export. export is NOT a token here.

occupancy.description: first-party: targetNativeId is a first-party inventory subject of targetUniverse. external: attributed outside first-party inventory. unknown: producer/host could not decide. unknown occupancy is NOT occupancy=external and is NOT a false match.

exported.description: Tri-state for kind=symbol only (same tokens as subject-inventory InventoryRowV1.exported). MUST be null when kind is file, package, or unknown.

logicalPath.description: Optional ONLY when occupancy is external or unknown. MUST be null when occupancy=first-party (path lives on the inventory row). Never an invented first-party snapshot path for an external target.

proofInputRef.standing: NEW, pending root ProofInputRef / byDomain integration

x-opensip-join-law.standing: Host validates joins. A retained TargetAttributionV1 is PROVIDER ATTESTATION only. Host derivation is an EPHEMERAL projection and MUST NOT be written as this record or claimed as provider output. Both, when present, are checked. Unknown attestation MUST NOT override independently known inventory metadata.
x-opensip-join-law.evaluationSubject: subject3 / evaluation-subject is (universe, kind, nativeSubjectId). Kind is required to prevent file/package nativeId collision.
x-opensip-join-law.producerClosureKind: Native fact producerClosure must be a Plan-selected closure whose kind is provider (native principal law). kind=evaluator in old fixtures is NOT a native fact producer; it is refused here (TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_PRODUCER_NOT_PROVIDER). No invented provider-kind alias.
joins: sourceFactId is a fact2 of that Plan
producerClosure equals fact.producerClosure, is Plan-selected, and closures[producerClosure].kind=provider
targetNativeId equals the payload field named by evaluator-projection-registry.v1.json relations[fact.relation].targetNativeIdField at fact.resolution
x-opensip-join-law.inventoryIdentity: An admitted subject identity is the triple (universe, kind, nativeSubjectId). Derivation uniqueness counts DISTINCT triples after reconciling equivalent observations across capability inventories. Two inventory rows of the same triple are one identity, not ambiguity.

derivation.when: targetNativeIdField is present and the set of distinct (universe=fact.targetUniverse, kind, nativeSubjectId=targetNativeId) identities across admitted SubjectInventoryV1 rows of this Plan has size 1
derivation.action: host computes an ephemeral projection {occupancy:first-party, kind, exported or null, logicalPath:null}. It is not a TargetAttributionV1 and not a provider output.
derivation.sizeZero: no first-party identity; ephemeral occupancy is not first-party. Sidecar occupancy=first-party then refuses TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_FIRST_PARTY_NOT_IN_INVENTORY. Sidecar occupancy=external is consistent. Absent sidecar: occupancy unknown.
derivation.sizeGreaterThanOne: ambiguous first-party identities (different kinds for the same nativeId in the same universe). Ephemeral kind/occupancy unknown. Sidecar supplying a known kind that equals exactly one of those identities is still refused if the DISTINCT set size > 1 without exact reconciliation to one triple.

conflictRefusals.TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_KIND_INVENTORY_DISAGR: sidecar.kind in {file,symbol,package} AND ephemeral known kind differs
conflictRefusals.TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_EXPORTED_INVENTORY_DI: sidecar.exported in {exported,not-exported} AND ephemeral exported in {exported,not-exported} AND they differ
conflictRefusals.TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_UNKNOWN_OVERRIDE: not a silent override: unknown sidecar fields are ignored where ephemeral is known; they do not wipe known kind/occupancy/exported

x-opensip-join-law.reconciliation: Prefer independently known ephemeral fields. Fill remaining unknown from sidecar. Result used for matching is the reconciled projection, never raw sidecar alone.
x-opensip-join-law.absence: No sidecar and no unique first-party identity: kind/occupancy unknown, not nomatch, not false. Different targetNativeId vs current nativeSubjectId is known nomatch even if kind/occupancy unknown.
x-opensip-join-law.noBacklink: fact2 descriptors are unchanged. This record names sourceFactId; no fact field names an attribution digest.
